headline: Sales dip and profit falls sharply on US distribution shift
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 97.5B (-7.9% y/y) and operating profit KRW 18.1B (-61.8% y/y); EPS was KRW 305, down 90.8% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 305 fell 92.4% q/q and 90.8% y/y. Preliminary figures put revenue at KRW 97.5B, operating profit at KRW 18.1B and net profit near KRW 4.7B. Reports tie the drop to the US distribution transition, a lower share of high-margin toxin sales and higher SG&A. Nine-month revenue is up about 15%.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures are preliminary and come from news and StockHub reports. The causes are as reported by press and analysts, not read from the filing. EPS is Yahoo data.
